name: Lava Drop
summary: Generates a precisely timed 8–30-second photorealistic vertical video prompt for a fictional helicopter crewman dropping a giant object into an active lava lake, with material-specific impact physics, a cinematic payoff and a safe aftermath.
use_when: Use when the user wants a viral object-versus-lava video, a helicopter lava-drop stunt, object ideas for the format, or an exact 8–30-second photorealistic text-to-video prompt.
produces: One self-contained English video-generation prompt with contiguous timestamps, 24 fps, vertical handheld helicopter framing, object-specific lava reactions, sound design and continuity constraints.
